name: Champion Steel Works
old_description: Managing construction projects can be stressful. At Champion Steel Works, we deliver stress-free steel you can trust -- giving contractors the confidence and credibility to succeed.
about:
Champion Steel Works operates from Wilmington, Ohio, where it has fabricated structural steel since 1872. Originally established as Champion Bridge Company, the business remains family-led; President Noah Dell represents the latest generation after his father ran the company. The firm rebranded to Champion Steel Works to reflect a scope that now extends well beyond bridge work.

The shop produces more than 60 tons of fabricated steel each week, handling structural steel fabrication, project management, job-order-contract (JOC) proposals, and local metal supply. With over 150 years of experience and 8,465-plus contracts awarded, the team analyzes plans early to identify conflicts, fabricates to specification, quality-checks each piece, and schedules delivery to match project timelines.

Contractors across Ohio, Kentucky, the Carolinas, Indiana, Tennessee, Michigan, Georgia, Alabama, and Florida rely on the company for healthcare, commercial, institutional, and infrastructure projects. Recent work includes the Winton Hills Medical Center and a new medical office building, illustrating a focus on complex, schedule-driven construction.

The company emphasizes a proactive, detail-driven approach that eliminates guesswork, promising stress-free steel delivered on time and on budget. Its founding values — serving others, working hard, and building community with integrity and gratitude — remain the stated differentiator.
